proof_scope: Control metadata for successful and failed writes to 13 banks. This does not prove physical bank data, executor arithmetic, command dispatch, integrated timing or board operation.

checks.vivado_ooc_synthesis: PASS, Vivado 2025.2, xczu7ev-ffvc1156-2-e, 5.000 ns XDC applied during synthesis

covered_behaviors: state survives a four-cycle chunk gap without reset
same-bank overlap and out-of-order partial write signal error
limitations: Out-of-context timing has no HD.CLK_SRC and does not estimate integrated clock skew.
The module relies on matched issue and completion events from the dispatcher and executors; that wiring is not yet implemented.
No placed or routed implementation is claimed.
